title: ai-atoms model v1
description: A model atom — reference data about one AI model: who made it, what it does, how big it is, and where a runtime can get it. A model atom points at providers; it does not host weights.

id.description: Namespaced identifier in the form model/<slug>. Dots are allowed because model names carry versions (llama3.2, qwen2.5).

version.description: Semantic version of this atom (not of the model).

vendor.description: Organisation that trained the model (Meta, Alibaba, Google, Mistral AI...). 'unknown' when the provider does not say.

family.description: Model family or series (Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 3).

task.description: Primary task the model is built for.

capabilities.description: Feature flags a runtime can rely on: tools, vision, thinking, embedding, structured-output, cloud.

context_window_tokens.description: Maximum context length in tokens, when published.

license.description: Model weights license (SPDX id or the vendor's name for it, e.g. 'Llama 3.2 Community License'). 'unknown' when not published.

providers.description: Where a runtime can obtain or call this model. One entry per hosting provider.

name.description: Provider display name (Ollama, Cloudflare Workers AI, Anthropic API).

pull_command.description: Command that obtains the model locally, when the provider has one (ollama pull llama3.2).

run_command.description: Command that starts an interactive session, when the provider has one.

tag_count.description: Number of published variants/tags at the provider.

updated_at.description: Date the provider last updated the model.

planned_deprecation.description: Whether a deprecation timeline has been announced.

replacement.description: Recommended replacement model atom when deprecated.
